issues.title: Audit: Preserve mixer-enabled microphone audio across game and idle transitions

criteria.text: Run the actual observer path with legacy microphone=false plus mixer microphone_enabled=true; mic scene items remain connected in game and idle before/after transitions.
notes: Actual watchCaptureWith path with legacy false/mixer enabled; game A/idle/game B/idle; same-app enable policy cache refresh.

criteria.text: Check disabled, explicitly muted and push-to-talk preferences remain muted and never gain an implicit unmute.
notes: Disabled legacy override, explicitly muted and armed push-to-talk variants preserve seeded mute; no source audio mutation requests or preference writes. Does not qualify physical hold-to-talk/controller behavior.

criteria.text: Verify game/idle transitions preserve gain, route, source mute and all independent output states; use protocol fixtures during repair and actual audible Deck clip/viewer evidence under #86.
notes: Seeded source device/gain/mute preserved; stream-only, record-only, replay-only and all-active fixture variants; no audio/output writes.

external_acceptance.required: Actual audible Deck microphone/game clip and remote viewer, headset/device routing, controller hold-to-talk.

issues.title: Audit: Recheck managed OBS ownership before capture observer mutations

criteria.text: Switch collection/profile or stop output during a blocked discovery callback: no scene/input mutation follows the stale observation.
notes: Covers profile, collection, stop, capture-mode and malformed output after blocked discovery; no scene/input writes.

criteria.text: Hold the shared control lease for an explicit stop/configuration: the watcher yields and later re-observes rather than acting on old state.
Starting output plus attaching the watcher while the initiating command holds its lease remains bounded and does not deadlock.
notes: Independent review found and reproduced false initial-error readiness. Fixed Watching=ready && failures<3 with exhaustion based separately on failures>=3. Read-only readiness reports unknown frames and requires known managed active observation.

criteria.text: Retain game-only privacy: no full-display fallback and no automatic output start/restart.

external_acceptance.required: Actual SteamOS/Gamescope app-only privacy and uninterrupted game transitions on supported Deck/OBS.

issues.title: Audit: Reject unknown recording state throughout lifecycle confirmation

criteria.text: Table-test omitted, null and wrong-type outputActive at each recording lifecycle observation; unknown preflight dispatches no StartRecord or StopRecord.
notes: Omitted/null/string/number/object/array active flags across runtime/start preflight/start confirmation/stop preflight/stop finalization. Unknown preflights dispatch no lifecycle mutation.

criteria.text: Malformed finalization polls return an error and no finalized path even after StopRecord ACK; valid delayed shutdown still waits until explicitly inactive.
notes: Malformed post-ACK finalization returns error/no finalized path; valid delayed shutdown requires explicitly inactive observation; canonical case aliases cannot fake inactivity.

criteria.text: RuntimeStatus and managed configuration/capture preflights cannot convert unknown recording state into idle authorization.
notes: Managed callers propagate RuntimeStatus error; capture observer malformed-output case forbids writes. Integrated status fixtures were repaired to supply the intentionally required paused observation and full integrated Go race now passes.

criteria.text: If outputPaused is exposed as known, omitted/null/wrong-type paused flags remain unknown/error rather than false.
notes: Paused required only at interfaces exposing it as known; exact raw canonical booleans drive exposed values, independent of SDK case-insensitive aliases.

criteria.text: Retain existing stream/record/replay coexistence, partial-media preservation and legacy request-ACK contracts; focused Go protocol/race checks only during repair, final matrix remains #85.
notes: Legacy record ACK behavior and bounded recording finalization are covered. Existing source preserves stream/replay independence and partial media; full final integrated checks remain pending.

external_acceptance.required: Actual recording finalization, audible clip and independent live/replay behavior on supported Deck/OBS.

issues.title: Audit: Invalidate OBS connections after response timeout or correlation loss

criteria.text: A delayed-ACK fixture with shorter SDK response budget than public deadline returns a safe timeout/unavailable failure and marks the connection closed.
notes: SDK response budget shorter than still-valid caller deadline; late ACK, observation, wrong-ID and workflow/profile/collection paths close client safely.

criteria.text: A subsequent operation on that client is rejected before any new request reaches the fixture; reconnect/observe remains caller-explicit.
notes: Second mutation rejected before fixture receives a new request; no implicit reconnect/retry. Independent review repaired workflow sanitization erasing timeout/correlation identity.

criteria.text: A valid numeric OBS rejection preserves obs_request plus its OBS code and need not poison the connection.
notes: Valid server numeric rejection stays obs_request with code; healthy connection accepts later legacy ACK operation. SDK-owned fixed error-prefix parsing is pinned to goobs v1.8.3.

criteria.text: Keep caller-deadline cancellation ownership, waiting-cancellation independence, once-only physical close, and no raw endpoint/key/server-message exposure.
notes: Acquired/waiting cancellation ownership, once-only shutdown and sanitized errors are covered in full affected-package race run.

issues.title: Audit: Make backend cancellation safe within Decky’s termination deadline

criteria.text: A faithful five-second loader stop fixture with slow microphone/dependency observations cannot permit a pending Start to mutate after backend death/reload acknowledgement
notes: Real disposable Linux processes/fake command, official module import name, five-second TERM/KILL fixture; no real OBS operation.

criteria.text: Late spawn ownership, active stream/record/replay, unknown output and abrupt parent death are tested separately; no forced kill of ordinary OBS or unrelated processes
notes: Late spawn and abrupt death use real disposable process fixtures with an unrelated-process sentinel. Teardown table now separately covers stream-only, recording-only, replay-only, recording-plus-replay and unknown observations; supplemental targeted run qualifies current test hash.
Frozen-loader fixed system Python and cleaned library/Python environment regression passes; actual supported SteamOS/Decky execution remains unrun.

criteria.text: All tracked RPC/read/update tasks have defined shutdown behavior and no child/lease is silently orphaned
notes: An ungranted late-attachment reaper may survive hook acknowledgement but cannot exec CLI and remains owned until attachment/parent death.
Physical read-only daemon update work may complete before backend exit; cancellation discards result and cannot block interpreter exit.
Existing bounded dependency worker may outlive adapter cleanup while retaining inherited leases; source keeps its recovery contract.

criteria.text: Document that hooks are best effort and cannot veto normal Decky replacement/removal; leave actual supported Decky/SteamOS execution unrun until owner test
notes: Canonical docs/runtime-correctness.md documents the pinned loader five-second deadline, adapter four-second budget, best-effort/no-veto hooks, late-attachment reaper, daemon read-only update work, separately bounded dependency worker leases, frozen system Python policy and explicit #86 deferral.

external_acceptance.required: Actual supported Decky/SteamOS replacement, reload, uninstall, frozen interpreter/process ownership and output observation after incomplete teardown.
